distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) documented Shaanxi (Shiquan); Huang & Lu (2015) retained Shaanxi, also listed by Yang (2020). Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) both reported Pinus armandii and Pinus tabulaeformis. Yang (2020) contributes distribution evidence only.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus pseudochinlingensis Tsai & Li, 1963.
